productUrl.title: Product page address
productUrl.description: Where your product pages live on your website, for example /shop/{slug}. {slug} is the product's short name in the address; {id}, {category} and {brand} work too.

categoryUrl.title: Category page address
categoryUrl.description: Where your category pages live on your website, for example /categories/{slug}. {path} adds the parent categories.

variantQuery.title: Variant address
variantQuery.description: What is added to a product page address to open one variant, for example grade={grade}&{attributes}. Empty: variants have no address of their own.

retiredUrl.title: Archived products
retiredUrl.description: Where an archived product's address leads when it names no replacement: nowhere (not found), or its category's page. Search engines treat many old addresses sent to one broad page as soft 404s: prefer a replacement for products with a near match.

pageSize.title: Products per page
pageSize.description: How many products the product grid shows at a time (1 to 60).

lowStock.title: Low stock at
lowStock.description: A variant still for sale with 1 to this many units counts as low on stock (archived products and variants marked sold out are left out): the products list's low-stock filter and counts, and Shop health. 0: no variant is low.

showStock.title: Show stock to shoppers
showStock.description: Whether shoppers see how many units are left: never, only when few are left, or always.

lowStockShown.title: Few left at
lowStockShown.description: With Show stock set to only when few are left, the number of units left is shown at this many or fewer.

search.title: Search
search.description: Basic search matches every word; Atlas Search is fuzzy and ranked, and needs the search index described in the docs on your database (MongoDB Atlas). If the index is missing, basic search answers and Overview says so.

searchMatch.title: Basic search matches
searchMatch.description: Every word anywhere in the name, summary, tags or SKUs; or the whole phrase, words in order, in the name or a SKU. For the shop's basic search.

defaultChartId.title: Default size chart
defaultChartId.description: The id of the chart (szc_…) a product shows when neither it, its brand nor its categories have one. Empty: none. A product that hides its size guide shows none.

enableVariants.title: Product variants
enableVariants.description: Sell products with options (size, colour) and variants.

enableSizeCharts.title: Size charts
enableSizeCharts.description: Attach size charts to products and brands.

enableMeasuredSales.title: Sold by measure
enableMeasuredSales.description: Sell by weight or length with decimal quantities.

enableWishlist.title: Wishlist
enableWishlist.description: Shoppers can save products to a wishlist.

enableCompare.title: Compare
enableCompare.description: Shoppers can compare products side by side.

enableAlerts.title: Stock and price alerts
enableAlerts.description: Back-in-stock and price-drop alerts for shoppers.

enableCsv.title: CSV import and export
enableCsv.description: Import and export catalog data as CSV.

enableBulkActions.title: Bulk actions
enableBulkActions.description: Edit many products at once in the catalog admin.

enableEvents.title: Event API
enableEvents.description: Forward shop events to your own integrations.
